buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar

proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DDO WCD DEPTT payable at Bhubaneswar . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name DDO WCD DEPTT Account No. 06640200002331 IFSC Code UCBA0000664 Bank Name UCO Bank Branch address Bhubaneswar . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 9. Financial Criteria

NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 10. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 11. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 2 samples for Buyer's approval, within 7 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 7 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) stipulated herein shall prevail over and supersede any conflicting provisions mentioned elsewhere in the bid document. In case of any inconsistenc y, the provisions of these ATC clauses shall be final and binding. 1. Past Performance: The Bidder or its OEM (themselves or through reseller(s)) should have regularly manu factured and supplied same or similar category products to any Central/State Government Organization/PS U for at least 10% of the estimated bid value, cumulatively during the last three financial years i.e., FY 202 3-24, FY 2024-25, and FY 2025-26. Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates such as CRAC or delivery receipts shall be submitted as documentary evidence in support of the cumulative val ue of supplies made during the relevant financial years. 2. Financial Year Definition: For the purpose of evaluation under this bid, the ‘last three financial years’ sha ll be interpreted as follows: 1. a. For Past Performance, the ‘last three financial years’ shall mean FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, and FY 2025-26; 2. b. For OEM Existence, OEM Financial Standing, OEM Financial Strength, Registration under GST Act, and other related eligibility criteria, the "last three financial years" shall mean FY 2022-23, FY 2023- 24, and FY 2024-25, with the last financial year considered as FY 2 024-25. 3. OEM Existence: The OEM should be in existence and operational for the last 20 years as on the bid subm ission date. Copies of Incorporation Certificate, and PAN shall be submitted. 4. Affidavit: Bidder must submit an Affidavit stating that neither the Bidder nor its OEM has been blackliste d by any Central/State Government / UT / PSU / other Government Organization. 5. Declaration on Land Border: As per Rule 144(xi) of GFR 2017, restrictions on procurement from a bidder of a country sharing a land border with India apply. The bidder or its OEM shall submit a declaration on the ir letterhead confirming compliance with the said provisions. 6. Experience Documentation: Where a CRAC is not available, past experience shall be demonstrated by s ubmitting relevant work order along with either completion certificate or delivery receipt issued by the con cerned client/authority. 7. Bidder Financial Standing: The Bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership, or similar proc eedings and should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload an undertaking to this effect with the bid.

8. OEM Financial Standing: The OEM should not be under liquidation, court receivership, or similar proceedi ngs and should not be bankrupt. OEM to upload an undertaking to this effect with the bid. 9. OEM Financial Strength: OEMs must demonstrate adequate financial strength and operational scale. Min imum annual turnover of ₹2,000 crore (FY 2024-25 as per Audited Financial Statements or equivalent) shal l be considered compliant. Copies of audited statements shall be submitted. 10. Registration under GST Act: Bidders must be registered under GST Act and submit a valid GSTIN certifi cate. 11. Product Launch Year: The offered Smart TV model should have been launched in 2024 or later, and sho uld not be obsolete. OEM certification confirming the model’s launch year shall be submitted. 12. OEM Certifications: The OEM of the offered products (TV) must have ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 45001:2018 certification. Copies of valid certificates shall be submitted. 13. FTA Channels: The proposed Smart TV shall provide access to a minimum of 150+ free-to-air (FTA) cha nnels approved by the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting. OEM declaration shall be submitted. 14. Technical Compliance Checklist: Bidder must upload a signed copy of the compliance with the Technic al Specifications and Additional Specification Parameters on OEM letterhead with the bid. 15. Manufacturer's Authorisation Form (MAF): The Bidder is required to submit a bid-specific Manufacturer' s Authorisation Form (MAF) from the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for the respective items. The MAF shall include the full address and contact details (email ID and phone number) of the authorised deale r. 16. Supply, Installation and Commissioning: The Smart TVs shall be supplied and installed, including mand atory wall-mounting, at 8,513 AWCs across the 25 Districts mentioned in the Bid Document. Installation, c ommissioning, testing, configuration and training shall be carried out by the OEM, OEM-certified resource o r OEM-authorised reseller. The bidder shall submit an undertaking confirming compliance at the bid submi ssion stage and provide installation/acceptance evidence as required by the Department. 17. Delivery Period: The delivery period of 90 days will start from the date the Buyer approves the sample. The Bidder acknowledges and undertakes, through a declaration to be uploaded with the bid, to complete the supply and installation within this period. Documentary evidence of sample approval will be maintaine d. 18. Service Centres: The successful bidder shall ensure availability of Service Centres in all 25 designated districts. Where unavailable at the time of bidding, the bidder/OEM shall establish the same within 30 days of award. An undertaking on the bidder's letterhead shall be submitted confirming compliance, including p rovision of customer support through telephone, WhatsApp, and email. The bidder/OEM shall provide a dist rict-wise list with address and contact details. For centres established post-award, documentary evidence shall be submitted within the stipulated timeline. 19. OEM Helpdesk: OEM shall provide at least one Toll-Free Helpdesk number, which shall remain operatio nal 24×7. The Toll-Free number shall be indicated on the OEM website. The Bidder shall submit a declarati on on OEM letterhead confirming the Toll-free number and operational timings. 20. Free Upgradation: The OEM shall provide, at no additional cost, all upgrades to the latest version of th e Smart TV Operating System, including security patches and feature enhancements, as released during th e warranty period. Declaration on OEM letterhead shall be submitted. 21. Warranty: The successful bidder shall provide an undertaking on the bidder's official letterhead, duly si gned and stamped, confirming provision of 1 (one) year Onsite Comprehensive Warranty, inclusive of the d isplay panel, from the date of successful supply, installation, and acceptance of the equipment. During the warranty period, the bidder shall ensure deployment of adequate dedicated technical service personnel / e ngineers for attending service requests in a time-bound manner and for ensuring timely servicing and recti fication of defects in accordance with the Buyer Added ATC defined in the bid. 22. Timely Servicing / Rectification during Warranty Period: If any defect or service requirement is reporte d during the warranty period, the Bidder shall complete the required servicing or rectification within 7 days from the date of notification. If the Bidder fails to do so, the Buyer will charge a penalty of 0.5% of the unit price per week of delay. The penalty may be paid directly by the Bidder or adjusted from payments includi ng PBG. Total penalty shall not exceed 10% of the contract value. Beyond this limit, Buyer may get the ser vice done through alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller, and the Seller shall reimburse the Bu yer for such cost.

23. Responsibility of Seller for Delivery and Replacement: The Bidder shall ensure that all Goods are delive red in good condition as per the specifications of the Contract. If any Goods are found to be damaged or d efective at the time of delivery or during the warranty period, the Bidder shall replace the same with new Goods at no additional cost to the Buyer within 15 days from notification. If the Bidder fails to replace the Goods within the specified time, the Buyer will charge a penalty at 0.5% per week or part of a week on the value of the defective Goods, subject to a maximum of 10%, adjustable from pending payments or PBG. 24. Liquidated Damages: If the Seller fails to deliver the Goods within the delivery period specified in the C ontract, the Buyer will charge a penalty at the rate of 0.5% per week or part of a week on the value of the delayed quantity of Goods, for the period of delay, subject to a maximum of 10% of the value of the delaye d quantity. The penalty will be applied only to the delayed portion, and no penalty will be charged on Goo ds delivered on time. The penalty amount will be adjusted from the payments payable to the Bidder, such as pending bills, and if required, from the Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG), unless the delay is due to F orce Majeure conditions. Documentary evidence of delivery delay or partial delivery shall be submitted by the Buyer. 25. Additional/Repeat Orders: The Buyer reserves the right to place additional or repeat orders up to fifty p ercent (50%) of the original contracted quantity, in accordance with the provisions of OGFR 2023, at the sa me rates, terms, and conditions. The Bidder shall submit an undertaking on its letterhead, duly signed and stamped, confirming acceptance of this clause and the validity of the quoted L1 rates till 6 months from th e work order. 26. Bid Cancellation and Jurisdiction: The Authority reserves the right to cancel the bid process at any stag e without assigning any reason. No claims or objections shall be entertained. All legal disputes shall be su bject to the jurisdiction of Khordha District only. 27. Checklist Compliance: A checklist of all required documents is attached as part of the uploaded ATC. It is mandatory to maintain all documents strictly as per the checklist, with document names and page numb ers corresponding to the checklist format. Bidders must provide a signed copy of the checklist along with t he bid on the GeM portal, confirming that all documents are complete, properly named, and placed accord ing to the checklist. . 13.
